question: In a certain code language. ‘MENIAL’ is coded as ‘NIEAML’ and ‘INCOME' is coded as ‘CONMIE’. What is the code for ‘FOREGO’ in the given code language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] Logic: No specific pattern is followed here, letters are shifted randomly within the word. ​​So, ‘MENIAL’ is coded as ‘NIEAML’ ​
